title: UP typing-layer case expectation
description: The expected outcome of applying the typing layer (spec §9) to the sibling input.up. One object per case directory under typing/cases/.

expect.description: Whether the typing processor MUST yield a typed model (typed) or report a typing error (error).

model.description: expect=typed only. The typed data model, as an order-significant JSON projection over the parse projection: an untyped member keeps its parse projection (string/object/array); a member whose annotation resolved to a type semantic projects as {"$type": <name>, "$value": <canonical form>} — $type is the resolved type name (a bare name resolves in the sealed core namespace: int ≡ up.type.int, spec §9) and $value is the value's canonical form as a string. Typing never coerces the parse model; scalars stay strings.

mode.description: The typing mode the case MUST be run under. "open" lets unresolved extension names pass through untyped (core-namespace failures still error, spec §9). Absent means the default strict mode.

code.description: expect=error only. The stable typing error code (T_*) the processor MUST report — a code space disjoint from the parse E_*/W_* spaces. Match by code, not message text.

line.description: expect=error only. The 1-based input line the error MUST be reported at (a failing list element under distribution reports its own line, spec §9).

note.description: Human-readable explanation of what the case pins.
